atmosphere.approvalState: provisional art direction; does not alter approved gameplay structure

gameplayRules: No contour form may create a dominant firing position into a base exit.
Main and secondary vehicle routes stay on gentle grades in the first graybox.
Contour lines are a planning preview; World Builder terrain height and pathing remain authoritative.

sectorPreview.method: Voronoi preview clipped to the 320 x 320 playable area
sectorPreview.meaning: Each preview cell is associated with its start or capture point; final World Builder sector polygons may be adjusted for roads, cover and supply clarity.
